convention.naming: Upper case, digits and underscores only.
convention.ordering: Domains alphabetical, datasets alphabetical within a domain.
convention.identity: The name is the stable identifier. The number is a position and moves when a dataset is inserted alphabetically, so nothing should store it.

domains.ATMOSPHERE: What happens above the surface: precipitation, temperature, humidity, radiation and evaporative demand.
domains.LAND: The surface itself: cover, use, soil and terrain.
domains.REFERENCE: The frames everything else is measured against — administrative and hydrological geography that is not itself a measurement.
domains.WATER: Water in the landscape: catchments, rivers, lakes and the routing between them.

datasets.name: CAMS_BASIN_DAILY
datasets.what: Aerosol optical depth and PM2.5 per level-6 basin from the CAMS +0h analysis — the assimilated estimate of what the atmosphere was, not a forecast.

datasets.name: CAMS_FORECAST_SKILL
datasets.what: How far CAMS forecasts diverge from their own analysis at 24 to 120 hours ahead: error, bias and correlation per lead time. Tells a user of the state table how far ahead the product is worth believing.

datasets.name: CFSV2_BASIN_ANOMALY
datasets.what: Basin monthly state expressed as z-scores against its own climatological normal.

datasets.name: CFSV2_BASIN_CLIMATOLOGY
datasets.what: Mean and standard deviation per basin, month and variable over a stated baseline.

datasets.name: CFSV2_BASIN_MONTHLY
datasets.what: Monthly mean land-atmosphere state per level-7 basin from the 6-hourly CFSv2 field.

datasets.name: CHIRPS_V3_BASIN_PENTAD
datasets.what: Pentadal precipitation total per level-12 basin at 5.6 km — six per month. CHIRPS is computed at this scale and its daily product is a disaggregation of it, so this is the authoritative quantity. Monthly and seasonal totals are sums of pentads and are derived rather than stored.

datasets.name: CHIRTS_BASIN_MONTHLY
datasets.what: Monthly temperature and humidity statistics per level-12 basin from CHIRTS-daily at 5.6 km, including counts of days above 35 and 40 degrees that only a daily record can give. Closed: the record runs 1983 to 2016 and stops.

datasets.name: CPC_BASIN_MONTHLY
datasets.what: Monthly temperature statistics per level-6 basin from the CPC gauge-based half-degree analysis, 1979 to the present, with the station count that informed each cell.

datasets.name: GHM_UNIT_MODIFICATION
datasets.what: Human modification index for 2016 at 1 km, reduced over both level-12 basins and districts: the mean plus the share of area in each modification band. The only timeless layer here — one image, no timestamp.

datasets.name: LANDCOVER_ADMIN_YEAR
datasets.what: Area of each land cover class per district per year.

datasets.name: LANDCOVER_BASIN_YEAR
datasets.what: Area of each land cover class per level-12 basin per year. Not yet built.

datasets.name: ADMIN_BASIN_LINKS
datasets.what: Shared area between every level-12 basin and every province and district.

datasets.name: ATLAS_BASIN_COVERAGE
datasets.what: Which environmental atlas layers overlap which level-12 basin, and by how much.

datasets.name: ATLAS_BASIN_STATISTICS
datasets.what: What each atlas raster reads inside each level-12 basin.

datasets.name: BASINATLAS_DOWNSTREAM_ROUTING
datasets.what: Which basin each BasinATLAS basin drains into.

datasets.name: BASINATLAS_PFAFSTETTER_HIERARCHY
datasets.what: Parent and child basins by Pfafstetter code, level 1 to 12.

datasets.name: BASINATLAS_SUBBASIN_HIERARCHY
datasets.what: Basin containment confirmed by spatial overlap rather than by code alone.

datasets.name: HYDROBASINS_LAKE_DOWNSTREAM_ROUTING
datasets.what: Downstream routing in the lake-format HydroBASINS extraction.

datasets.name: HYDROBASINS_LAKE_PFAFSTETTER_HIERARCHY
datasets.what: Pfafstetter parentage in the lake-format extraction.

datasets.name: HYDROBASINS_LAKE_SUBBASIN_HIERARCHY
datasets.what: Basin containment in the lake-format extraction.

datasets.name: HYDROGRAPHY_LAKE_BASIN
datasets.what: Which level-12 basin each lake sits in.

datasets.name: HYDROGRAPHY_RIVER_BASIN
datasets.what: Which level-12 basin each river reach drains.

datasets.name: HYDROGRAPHY_RIVER_DOWNSTREAM
datasets.what: Reach-to-reach downstream routing for the 17,447 published reaches.
